Dj.bar_b_note: Strong large arachnid silhouette, but the uniform chrome-gold metallic surface reads as a toy rather than the naturalistic plate/chitin of the style bar, and the faint-mid frame tips up into an unreadable tangle.

Ia.bar_b_note: Appealing long-eared golden silhouette, but the body sits well below the 1.80 m trainer and the faint-end tail runs through the trainer's legs, so it fails the scale and finish bar.

Yb.bar_b_note: A grounded fur-and-mossy-stone boar that clearly outsizes the trainer and reads in every pose including the rolled faint carried it, though the rider is tiny on the back.

Fy.bar_b_note: B's grounded mottled black-gold coils and open-mouth read are close, but A's flat banded yellow material and the faint-mid/faint-end bodies floating high off the stage with detached shadows sink the set.

Cv.bar_b_note: B's larger, fully wrapped recipe text on a blue-grey translucent panel is serviceable, but there is no teal focus state or controller glyphs and the murky dark rainy world behind it is far from Palworld's bright readable HUD-over-world.

Qn.bar_b_note: A clear white-blue-orange crested serpent-bird that towers over the trainer and reads in hit and faint poses carried it, with only flat stage lighting holding it back.

Gr.bar_b_note: The brown cobra has a decent scale texture, but no trainer ruler is visible in any frame so scale cannot be confirmed, and faint-end is almost identical to standing (head still raised) so the faint does not read.

Fo.bar_b_note: This brown storm bear with purple lightning veins matches the owner's Stormursa bar, out-scales the trainer and reads in every pose.

Oe.bar_b_note: The spotted lizard with flame frills has a good pattern, but it is long and low (back barely at trainer height) and in faint-end the flipped dark body and tail pass through the trainer.

Ld.bar_b_note: The crested blue-white bird is readable and taller than the trainer, but in faint-end the wing lies over the trainer and the carrying frame shows it hovering with nothing visibly carried.

Fv.bar_b_note: B adds a timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing, but the infill is still a flat untextured beige card and it stands alone like an outhouse door beside a faceted placeholder boulder, under a painted-backdrop mountain sky with no atmosphere.

Hm.bar_b_note: A naturalistic furred bear with bright violet lightning seams that dwarfs the trainer and has a clearly readable sprawled faint carried it.

Ht.bar_b_note: The navy armoured, orange-spiked ankylosaur has a strong plated silhouette above trainer height, held back only by a small head and a dark body that is low in value on the grey stage.

Dn.bar_b_note: This warm, appealing elder with a green vest and scarf has an earthy palette that fits the village, but the large-eyed animated-film face is more cartoon than the key art's stylised realism.

Ah.bar_b_note: The blue-and-orange finned water dragon has a striking, tall silhouette, but the ridden frame shows no visible rider and the faint frames flatten into an unreadable fin pile.

top_changes.change: Fix creature scale and staging on the turntable: scale up sub-trainer creatures (Ia, Oe) so they stand clearly taller than 1.80 m, stop faint poses from overlapping or clipping the trainer (Ia, Oe, Ld), keep faint bodies on the ground (Fy A), and always show the ruler and the rider (Gr, Ah).

Rebuild the homestead wall as a thick log/wattle or plank-and-stone piece with a textured, weathered infill and real depth, so it reads as a built wall that belongs in the world rather than a single framed card.

Finish the craft UI to the art direction: controller-first button glyphs next to bold hint labels, teal/cyan focus on the selected recipe, gold for craftable progress, and keep the larger wrapped recipe text.
